examples.en: I had a tiring day at school.
examples.zh: 我在学校度过了累人的一天。

examples.en: Taking care of kids is very tiring.
examples.zh: 照看孩子非常累人。

examples.en: They don't visit London often because it's too tiring with kids.
examples.zh: 他们不常去伦敦，因为带孩子太累了。

examples.en: She stepped back and fell over a chair.
examples.zh: 她后退一步，被椅子绊倒了。

examples.en: They stepped out onto the balcony.
examples.zh: 他们走到阳台上。

examples.en: Be careful not to step in the mud.
examples.zh: 小心别踩到泥里。

examples.en: I made a red Chinese knot for my mom.
examples.zh: 我给妈妈做了一个红色的中国结。

examples.en: The Chinese knot hangs on the wall.
examples.zh: 那个中国结挂在墙上。

examples.en: She learned to make a Chinese knot in art class.
examples.zh: 她在美术课上学做了中国结。

examples.en: My grandma loves watching Chinese opera on TV.
examples.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在电视上看中国戏曲。

examples.en: We learned about Chinese opera in our art class.
examples.zh: 我们在美术课上了解了中国戏曲。

examples.en: The Chinese opera show will start at seven tonight.
examples.zh: 中国戏曲演出今晚七点开始。

examples.en: Chinese paper-cutting is a traditional folk art in China.
examples.zh: 中国剪纸是中国的传统民间艺术。

examples.en: My grandma makes Chinese paper-cutting for the Spring Festival.
examples.zh: 我奶奶为春节做中国剪纸。

examples.en: We put up Chinese paper-cutting on the windows to celebrate New Year.
examples.zh: 我们把中国剪纸贴在窗户上来庆祝新年。

examples.en: He used ivory chopsticks to eat rice from a bowl every evening.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上用象牙筷子从碗里吃米饭。

examples.en: On the table there are four bowls, two dishes, and a bag with chopsticks.
examples.zh: 桌子上有四个碗、两个小碟子，还有一个装着筷子的纸袋。

examples.en: We used forks and chopsticks, and each guest had soy or vinegar.
examples.zh: 我们用叉子和筷子，每位客人都有酱油或醋。

examples.en: The children did a dragon dance for the celebration.
examples.zh: 孩子们为了庆祝表演了舞龙。

examples.en: Big store openings often have dragon dances and fireworks.
examples.zh: 大型商店开业时常有舞龙和烟花。

examples.en: Chinese people here celebrate with dragon dances and food.
examples.zh: 这里的中国人用舞龙和美食来庆祝。

examples.en: This is my class photo. I'm in the middle.
examples.zh: 这是我的班级照。我在中间。

examples.en: They walked in the middle of the road.
examples.zh: 他们走在路的中间。

examples.en: The noise woke us in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 噪音在半夜把我们吵醒了。

examples.en: I was in the middle of my homework when he called.
examples.zh: 他打电话来的时候，我正在做作业。

examples.en: The school is in the middle of a small town.
examples.zh: 这所学校在一个小镇的中心。

examples.en: She sat in the middle of the classroom and listened carefully.
examples.zh: 她坐在教室中间，认真听讲。

examples.en: He dressed up as an emperor for the party.
examples.zh: 他打扮成皇帝去参加聚会。

examples.en: This porcelain was made only for the emperor.
examples.zh: 这种瓷器是专门为皇帝制作的。

examples.en: The emperor ruled Japan from 1926 to 1989.
examples.zh: 这位皇帝从1926年到1989年统治日本。

examples.en: Please raise your hand if you agree.
examples.zh: 如果你同意，请举手。

examples.en: He raised the window and looked out.
examples.zh: 他抬起窗户，向外看去。

examples.en: Mary Quant was the first to raise skirt lengths.
examples.zh: 玛丽·匡特是第一个提高裙摆长度的人。

examples.en: Flags of all the countries are flying outside the stadium.
examples.zh: 所有国家的旗帜都在体育场外飘扬。

examples.en: The palace flies a flag when the king is at home.
examples.zh: 国王在家时，王宫会升起旗帜。

examples.en: The flags were flapping in the wind.
examples.zh: 旗帜在风中飘动。

examples.en: We saw a beautiful rural landscape on our way.
examples.zh: 我们在路上看到了一片美丽的乡村风景。

examples.en: Builders are busy changing the urban landscape.
examples.zh: 建筑工人们正忙着改变城市的面貌。

examples.en: The landscape is dotted with campers' tents.
examples.zh: 这片风景上点缀着露营者的帐篷。

examples.en: The city has many attractions, like parks and museums.
examples.zh: 这座城市有很多吸引人的地方，比如公园和博物馆。

examples.en: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 长城是一个著名的旅游景点。

examples.en: Traveling is a big attraction of this job.
examples.zh: 旅行是这份工作的一大吸引力。

examples.en: The guard at the watchtower saw the smoke far away.
examples.zh: 瞭望塔上的守卫看到了远处的烟。

examples.en: From the watchtower, we can watch the animals in the forest.
examples.zh: 从瞭望塔上，我们能观察森林里的动物。

examples.en: The old watchtower was used to watch for fires in the city.
examples.zh: 那座旧瞭望塔过去用来监视城里的火灾。

examples.en: Your parents will wonder where you are. Call them now.
examples.zh: 你的父母会想知道你在哪里。现在给他们打电话吧。

examples.en: He wonders if taking the job was right.
examples.zh: 他怀疑接受这份工作是否是正确的。

examples.en: I wonder if this turkey is big enough for eight.
examples.zh: 我想知道这只火鸡是否够八个人吃。

examples.en: He likes to lie in bed on Sundays.
examples.zh: 他喜欢星期天躺在床上。

examples.en: She lies on a beach to enjoy the sun.
examples.zh: 她躺在沙滩上享受阳光。

examples.en: Please lie on your side for the photo.
examples.zh: 请侧躺着拍照。

examples.en: Clay can turn into almost any shape.
examples.zh: 黏土可以变成几乎任何形状。

examples.en: These bricks have different shapes.
examples.zh: 这些砖头有不同的形状。

examples.en: Kim's cake was in the shape of a train.
examples.zh: Kim的蛋糕是火车形状的。

examples.en: The explorers found a dark underground cave.
examples.zh: 探险家们发现了一个黑暗的地下洞穴。

examples.en: We walked through a long underground passage.
examples.zh: 我们走过了一条长长的地下通道。

examples.en: Workers are laying an underground cable now.
examples.zh: 工人们正在铺设地下电缆。

examples.en: We saw old cave paintings on the wall.
examples.zh: 我们在墙上看到了古老的洞穴壁画。

examples.en: His scream echoed inside the cave for seconds.
examples.zh: 他的尖叫声在洞穴里回响了几秒钟。

examples.en: She was badly hurt in a cave accident in France.
examples.zh: 她在法国的一次洞穴事故中受了重伤。

examples.en: A heavy gold necklace hung around her neck.
examples.zh: 一条沉重的金项链挂在她脖子上。

examples.en: A big bunch of keys hung from her belt.
examples.zh: 一大串钥匙挂在她腰带上。

examples.en: Party decorations hung down from the ceiling.
examples.zh: 派对装饰物从天花板垂挂下来。

examples.en: Let's talk about the first point in your essay.
examples.zh: 我们来谈谈你文章中的第一个要点。

examples.en: You made a good point in your speech.
examples.zh: 你在演讲中提出了一个好观点。

examples.en: I want to make this point clear to you.
examples.zh: 我想把这个要点跟你讲清楚。

examples.en: She looked upwards at the sun.
examples.zh: 她抬头看向太阳。

examples.en: The price has been revised upwards again.
examples.zh: 价格又被上调了。

examples.en: House prices are moving upwards again.
examples.zh: 房价又开始上涨了。

examples.en: How much is it to hire a car for the weekend?
examples.zh: 周末租一辆车要多少钱？

examples.en: You can hire a dress for the ball if you can't buy one.
examples.zh: 如果你买不起礼服，可以租一件去舞会。

examples.en: The first company I asked hired me.
examples.zh: 我申请的第一家公司就雇用了我。

examples.en: The eastern part of the country has many mountains.
examples.zh: 这个国家的东部有很多山。

examples.en: Before 1991, the Eastern bloc included the Soviet Union and eastern Europe.
examples.zh: 1991年之前，东方集团包括苏联和东欧。

examples.en: Buddhism and other Eastern religions interest me a lot.
examples.zh: 佛教和其他东方宗教让我很感兴趣。

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the south-east.
examples.zh: 风正从东南方吹来。

examples.en: Our school is in the south-east of the city.
examples.zh: 我们学校在城市的东南部。

examples.en: They walked south-east to find the river.
examples.zh: 他们向东南方走去寻找那条河。

examples.en: The hotel is in a beautiful location near the lake.
examples.zh: 这家酒店位于湖边一个风景优美的地方。

examples.en: We will send you a map of the property's location.
examples.zh: 我们会给你寄一张标有房产位置的地图。

examples.en: She chose to retire early instead of moving to the new location.
examples.zh: 她选择提前退休，而不是搬到新的地方。

examples.en: The big sofa takes up too much space in my room.
examples.zh: 这个大沙发在我房间里占了太多空间。

examples.en: Learning English takes up two hours every day.
examples.zh: 学英语每天占用两个小时。

examples.en: Don't let games take up all your free time.
examples.zh: 别让游戏占据你所有的空闲时间。

examples.en: He cut the orange into four quarters.
examples.zh: 他把橙子切成了四份。

examples.en: Under a quarter of the people said they were happy.
examples.zh: 不到四分之一的人说他们很幸福。

examples.en: My house is a mile and three quarters away.
examples.zh: 我家离这里一又四分之三英里。

examples.en: I don't like apples, and my sister doesn't either.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢苹果，我姐姐也不喜欢。

examples.en: "I haven't seen that movie." "I haven't either."
examples.zh: “我没看过那部电影。”“我也没看过。”

examples.en: The school has a nice library, and it isn't far either.
examples.zh: 这所学校有一个好图书馆，而且它也不远。

examples.en: The lake's water level is higher after heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨过后，湖里的水位更高了。

examples.en: Inflation will rise two percent from its current level.
examples.zh: 通货膨胀将从目前的水平上升两个百分点。

examples.en: Chess needs a very high level of concentration.
examples.zh: 下棋需要非常高的专注度。

examples.en: The postal service sends letters and packages.
examples.zh: 邮政服务寄送信件和包裹。

examples.en: The National Park Service takes care of US parks.
examples.zh: 国家公园管理局负责照看美国的公园。

examples.en: The National Health Service gives free health care in the UK.
examples.zh: 英国国民医疗服务体系提供免费医疗。

examples.en: The Japanese stock market is going up.
examples.zh: 日本股市正在上涨。

examples.en: I like Japanese art very much.
examples.zh: 我非常喜欢日本艺术。

examples.en: Can you speak Japanese well?
examples.zh: 你日语说得好吗？

examples.en: The old school was in a bad state.
examples.zh: 这所旧学校状况很差。

examples.en: He was in a happy state of mind.
examples.zh: 他处于一种快乐的心境中。

examples.en: You are not in a state to drive now.
examples.zh: 你现在状态不好，不能开车。

examples.en: My friend can speak Hindi and English.
examples.zh: 我的朋友会说印地语和英语。

examples.en: We learned some Hindi words in class today.
examples.zh: 我们今天在课堂上学了一些印地语单词。

examples.en: Hindi is the main language in India.
examples.zh: 印地语是印度的主要语言。

examples.en: China has more than a billion people.
examples.zh: 中国有超过十亿人口。

examples.en: The beauty business makes billions of dollars.
examples.zh: 美容行业赚数十亿美元。

examples.en: The government spent billions on the plan.
examples.zh: 政府在这个计划上花费了数十亿。

examples.en: Ten percent of the population lived in poverty.
examples.zh: 百分之十的人口生活在贫困中。

examples.en: The population of Cairo was about 6.5 million in 1992.
examples.zh: 1992年，开罗的人口大约有650万。

examples.en: The population is growing quickly in some cities.
examples.zh: 一些城市的人口正在快速增长。

examples.en: Iron rusts easily in wet weather.
examples.zh: 铁在潮湿的天气里容易生锈。

examples.en: The manhole covers are made of iron.
examples.zh: 这些井盖是用铁做的。

examples.en: He was hit with an iron bar.
examples.zh: 他被一根铁棒打了。

examples.en: Where's my pen? It was on my desk. You left it by the phone.
examples.zh: 我的钢笔在哪里？它刚才还在桌上。你把它落在电话旁边了。

examples.en: The company lost money, so it had to fire some workers.
examples.zh: 公司亏钱了，所以它不得不裁掉一些工人。

examples.en: The talk made us sad. I don't want to talk about it.
examples.zh: 那次谈话让我们难过。我不想谈论它。

examples.en: Computer technology helps us learn and play.
examples.zh: 计算机技术帮助我们学习和娱乐。

examples.en: Modern technology is amazing, isn't it?
examples.zh: 现代技术很神奇，不是吗？

examples.en: Science and technology need long-term investment.
examples.zh: 科学和技术需要长期投资。

examples.en: This is an ancient local custom.
examples.zh: 这是一个古老的地方风俗。

examples.en: In my country, it's the custom for women to wear white at weddings.
examples.zh: 在我的国家，女性结婚穿白色是风俗。

examples.en: He left home at nine, as is his custom.
examples.zh: 他九点离开家，这是他的习惯。

examples.en: Everyone has the right to a fair trial.
examples.zh: 每个人都有权得到公正的审判。

examples.en: It's not fair that I must do all the cleaning.
examples.zh: 我必须做所有清洁，这不公平。

examples.en: It's not fair on Joe to give him all the work.
examples.zh: 把所有工作都给乔做，对他不公平。

examples.en: My aunt wears a long sari to the party.
examples.zh: 我阿姨穿了一条长长的莎丽去参加聚会。

examples.en: The red sari looks beautiful on her.
examples.zh: 那条红色莎丽穿在她身上很漂亮。

examples.en: She bought a new sari from India.
examples.zh: 她从印度买了一条新莎丽。

examples.en: This is an Indian family.
examples.zh: 这是一个印度家庭。

examples.en: The Indian ambassador is in Beijing.
examples.zh: 那位印度大使在北京。

examples.en: We met an Indian family on the street.
examples.zh: 我们在街上遇到了一个印度家庭。

examples.en: So inventors had to be more and more creative.
examples.zh: 所以发明者不得不越来越有创造力。

examples.en: Inventors used science to make new weapons.
examples.zh: 发明者用科学来制造新武器。

examples.en: Some people have new ideas and become inventors.
examples.zh: 有些人有新想法，就成了发明者。

examples.en: King C. Gillette invented the first safety razor in 1903.
examples.zh: 金·C·吉列在1903年发明了第一把安全剃刀。

examples.en: Can I invent a new way to make coffee for you?
examples.zh: 我能为你发明一种新的煮咖啡方法吗？

examples.en: People invented machines to help grow grapes in California.
examples.zh: 人们发明了机器来帮助加州种植葡萄。

examples.en: Magellan was a famous explorer in the 1500s.
examples.zh: 麦哲伦是16世纪一位著名的探险者。

examples.en: Explorers from France traded with Indians in North America.
examples.zh: 来自法国的探险者与北美印第安人进行贸易。

examples.en: Many explorers came to North America to trade with Indians.
examples.zh: 许多探险者来到北美与印第安人贸易。

examples.en: My new classmate is a South African.
examples.zh: 我的新同学是一个南非人。

examples.en: The South African taught us a fun song.
examples.zh: 那个南非人教了我们一首有趣的歌。

examples.en: Two South Africans joined our school team.
examples.zh: 两个南非人加入了我们学校的队伍。

examples.en: People know him as a brave fighter.
examples.zh: 人们都知道他是个勇敢的斗士。

examples.en: Our daughter is often in hospital, but she is a fighter.
examples.zh: 我们的女儿常住院，但她是个坚强的斗士。

examples.en: Fighters stopped the army 30 miles from the city.
examples.zh: 战斗者在离城市30英里处阻止了军队。

examples.en: The world changed fast after the invention of the phone.
examples.zh: 电话发明后，世界变化很快。

examples.en: It is a most amazing invention.
examples.zh: 这是一个非常了不起的发明。

examples.en: The invention of the pill greatly changed women's lives.
examples.zh: 这种药的发明极大地改变了女性的生活。

examples.en: Italian food is very popular in China.
examples.zh: 意大利食物在中国很受欢迎。

examples.en: We met three Italian friends at the party.
examples.zh: 我们在聚会上遇到了三位意大利朋友。

examples.en: I am learning Italian because I like it.
examples.zh: 我在学意大利语，因为我喜欢它。

examples.en: Paris is a beautiful European city.
examples.zh: 巴黎是一座美丽的欧洲城市。

examples.en: We learned about European history in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上学习了欧洲历史。

examples.en: A group of Europeans visited our school today.
examples.zh: 一群欧洲人今天参观了我们的学校。

examples.en: She is a Russian teacher at our school.
examples.zh: 她是我们学校的一位俄语老师。

examples.en: I want to learn Russian because it sounds beautiful.
examples.zh: 我想学俄语，因为它听起来很好听。

examples.en: His Russian friend taught him how to cook.
examples.zh: 他的俄罗斯朋友教他做饭。

examples.en: He is a fighter pilot in the air force.
examples.zh: 他是空军里的战斗机飞行员。

examples.en: My uncle is a helicopter pilot.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是一名直升机飞行员。

examples.en: She wants to be an airline pilot one day.
examples.zh: 她梦想有一天成为民航飞行员。

examples.en: The command pilot gave clear orders to the crew before takeoff.
examples.zh: 飞行指挥在起飞前向机组人员下达了明确指令。

examples.en: Our command pilot checked the weather and chose a safe route.
examples.zh: 我们的飞行指挥查看了天气，选择了安全航线。

examples.en: A command pilot must stay calm and make quick decisions in the air.
examples.zh: 飞行指挥在空中必须保持冷静并快速做决定。

examples.en: You need a licence to keep a dog.
examples.zh: 养狗需要执照。

examples.en: He got his driving licence last year.
examples.zh: 他去年拿到了驾驶执照。

examples.en: We must buy a TV licence for our home.
examples.zh: 我们家必须购买电视执照。

examples.en: The universities make discoveries and license them to a company.
examples.zh: 大学做出发现，并把它们许可给一家公司。

examples.en: Several companies are licensed to sell these products.
examples.zh: 几家公司获得了销售这些产品的许可证。

examples.en: A broker is also licensed to work with private lenders.
examples.zh: 经纪人也有执照，可以和私人贷款机构合作。

examples.en: My brother is a navy officer.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是一名海军军官。

examples.en: Gabriel joined the navy in 1997.
examples.zh: 加布里埃尔在1997年加入了海军。

examples.en: They saw a navy ship in the sea.
examples.zh: 他们在海上看到了一艘海军军舰。

examples.en: Do they serve food in the bar?
examples.zh: 酒吧里提供食物吗？

examples.en: Breakfast is served from 7 to 11 in the restaurant.
examples.zh: 餐厅在7点到11点供应早餐。

examples.en: We got to the hotel and were served drinks and snacks.
examples.zh: 我们到达酒店后，有人给我们端来了饮料和小吃。

examples.en: The class is having a spelling test today.
examples.zh: 全班今天有拼写测试。

examples.en: She took a test before getting the job.
examples.zh: 她在得到这份工作之前参加了一个测试。

examples.en: The doctor did a blood test on him.
examples.zh: 医生给他做了血液测试。

examples.en: Military aircraft fly very fast.
examples.zh: 军用飞机飞得非常快。

examples.en: Captain Firth sat at the controls of the aircraft.
examples.zh: 弗斯机长坐在飞机的操纵装置前。

examples.en: The airline is making sure its aircraft are safe.
examples.zh: 航空公司正在确保其飞机安全。

examples.en: Astronauts find it hard to move in low gravity.
examples.zh: 宇航员发现失重状态下移动很困难。

examples.en: Astronauts do exercise and take medicine to stay strong in space.
examples.zh: 宇航员在太空中做运动和吃药来保持强壮。

examples.en: Astronauts sleep in special beds so they don't hurt themselves.
examples.zh: 宇航员睡在特殊的床上，以免伤到自己。

examples.en: China sent a spacecraft with people into space.
examples.zh: 中国发射了一艘载人宇宙飞船进入太空。

examples.en: This unmanned spacecraft has no people in it.
examples.zh: 这艘无人宇宙飞船里面没有人。

examples.en: We can use the word 'spacecraft' with many verbs.
examples.zh: 我们可以把“宇宙飞船”这个词和许多动词搭配使用。

examples.en: The earth spins around its center.
examples.zh: 地球绕着它的中心旋转。

examples.en: The players watched the wheel spin around.
examples.zh: 玩家们看着轮盘旋转。

examples.en: His car spun off the road and hit a tree.
examples.zh: 他的车打滑冲出道路，撞到了树上。

examples.en: If you can't control your dog, keep it on a leash.
examples.zh: 如果你控制不了你的狗，就给它拴上绳子。

examples.en: You must learn to control your anger.
examples.zh: 你必须学会控制自己的怒气。

examples.en: A thermostat controls the room temperature.
examples.zh: 恒温器控制室温。

examples.en: The car was out of control and hit a tree.
examples.zh: 汽车失去控制，撞到了树上。

examples.en: The fire is out of control, so we must call 119.
examples.zh: 火势失控了，我们必须拨打119。

examples.en: He felt his life was out of control and needed help.
examples.zh: 他觉得自己的生活失控了，需要帮助。

examples.en: The waiter asked, "Can I take your order now?"
examples.zh: 服务员问：“现在可以为您点餐了吗？”

examples.en: I want to place an order for a big table.
examples.zh: 我想下订单买一张大桌子。

examples.en: I got an email that my order has been sent.
examples.zh: 我收到邮件说我的订单已经发货了。

examples.en: We had to cut the meeting short because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨，我们不得不缩短会议。

examples.en: She cut her visit short to go back to work.
examples.zh: 她缩短了访问，回去工作了。

examples.en: The teacher cut the class short to let us rest.
examples.zh: 老师缩短了课堂，让我们休息。

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
examples.zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。

examples.en: They took a boat trip across the Pacific last summer.
examples.zh: 他们去年夏天乘船横渡了太平洋。

examples.en: Many countries lie along the Pacific coast.
examples.zh: 许多国家位于太平洋沿岸。

examples.en: These strange animals live at the bottom of the ocean.
examples.zh: 这些奇怪的动物生活在海洋底部。

examples.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest of all the oceans.
examples.zh: 太平洋是所有海洋中最大的。

examples.en: We can see the ocean clearly from our hotel window.
examples.zh: 从我们酒店的窗户可以清楚地看到海洋。

examples.en: It is cheaper to drill for oil on land than at sea.
examples.zh: 在陆地上钻油比在海上便宜。

examples.en: The treaty has cut many land-based missiles in Europe.
examples.zh: 这项条约减少了欧洲许多陆基导弹。

examples.en: The army won't send land forces until air attacks finish their job.
examples.zh: 军队在空袭完成之前不会派出地面部队。

examples.en: Dad told us scary stories about a giant who ate kids.
examples.zh: 爸爸给我们讲可怕的巨人吃小孩的故事。

examples.en: In the play, we saw the giant's big hand in 'Jack and the Beanstalk'.
examples.zh: 在《杰克与豆茎》的剧里，我们看到了巨人的大手。

examples.en: People tell stories of an island where giants live, as tall as houses.
examples.zh: 人们传说有个岛上住着巨人，他们和房子一样高。

examples.en: He leaped out of the car and ran to the house.
examples.zh: 他跳出汽车，跑向房子。

examples.en: I leaped up to answer the phone.
examples.zh: 我跳起来去接电话。

examples.en: The dog leaped over the gate into the field.
examples.zh: 狗跳过大门，进了田野。

examples.en: Mankind has always loved power.
examples.zh: 人类一直热爱权力。

examples.en: Words often used with mankind.
examples.zh: 常与人类一起使用的词语。

examples.en: This will help all mankind.
examples.zh: 这将帮助全人类。

examples.en: Rain forests once covered 10% of the earth's surface.
examples.zh: 雨林曾经覆盖地球表面的10%。

examples.en: The marble's surface is smooth and shiny.
examples.zh: 大理石表面光滑闪亮。

examples.en: Neil Armstrong first stepped on the moon's surface.
examples.zh: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗首次踏上月球表面。

examples.en: I never read further than the first five pages of the book.
examples.zh: 这本书我从来都没读到超过前五页。

examples.en: We talked about the problem, but we didn't get further in solving it.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了这个问题，但在解决它方面没有取得更多进展。

examples.en: The matter is further complicated because Amanda and Jo won't talk to each other.
examples.zh: 因为阿曼达和乔互不说话，这件事变得更加复杂了。

examples.en: The British Embassy protects British citizens living abroad.
examples.zh: 英国大使馆保护住在国外的英国公民。

examples.en: He applied to become an American citizen.
examples.zh: 他申请成为美国公民。

examples.en: This will affect all citizens of this country.
examples.zh: 这将影响这个国家的所有公民。

examples.en: She watched him win the prize and felt great pride.
examples.zh: 她看着他获奖，感到非常骄傲。

examples.en: He walked his little daughter down the street with pride.
examples.zh: 他自豪地带着小女儿走在街上。

examples.en: She is the pride of her family.
examples.zh: 她是她家人的骄傲。

examples.en: A narrow passage goes through the house to the garden.
examples.zh: 一条狭窄的通道穿过房子通向花园。

examples.en: The bathroom is at the end of the passage on the right.
examples.zh: 浴室在通道尽头的右边。

examples.en: The air goes through the nasal passages when we breathe.
examples.zh: 我们呼吸时，空气经过鼻腔通道。

examples.en: She made this card by hand for her mother.
examples.zh: 她亲手为妈妈做了这张卡片。

examples.en: We wrote the letters by hand, not on the computer.
examples.zh: 我们用手写信，而不是用电脑。

examples.en: He drew the picture by hand with a pencil.
examples.zh: 他用铅笔手工画了这幅画。

examples.en: He is much better at mathematics than his classmates.
examples.zh: 他的数学比同学们好得多。

examples.en: You must know mathematics well to be an astronaut.
examples.zh: 你必须精通数学才能当宇航员。

examples.en: I learned pure mathematics in school.
examples.zh: 我在学校学了纯数学。

examples.en: She is a research scientist who studies the mind.
examples.zh: 她是一位研究心理的科研科学家。

examples.en: A nuclear scientist works with dangerous energy.
examples.zh: 核科学家研究危险的能源。

examples.en: The forensic scientist helps find clues at crime scenes.
examples.zh: 法医科学家在犯罪现场帮助寻找线索。

examples.en: Radium has the number 88 in the periodic table.
examples.zh: 镭在元素周期表中的序号是88。

examples.en: Radium can help treat cancer that has spread to bones.
examples.zh: 镭可以帮助治疗已经扩散到骨骼的癌症。

examples.en: Marie Curie and her husband won the Nobel Prize for finding radium.
examples.zh: 玛丽·居里和她的丈夫因发现镭而获得诺贝尔奖。

examples.en: We do science experiments in the research laboratory.
examples.zh: 我们在研究实验室里做科学实验。

examples.en: Our school has a new computer laboratory.
examples.zh: 我们学校有一个新的计算机实验室。

examples.en: Laboratory tests show the new drug can help treat cancer.
examples.zh: 实验室测试表明这种新药有助于治疗癌症。

examples.en: Professor Hawking was a great scientist.
examples.zh: 霍金教授是一位伟大的科学家。

examples.en: My father is a professor of sociology.
examples.zh: 我父亲是一位社会学教授。

examples.en: She became a sociology professor last year.
examples.zh: 她去年成为了一位社会学教授。

examples.en: Who is credited with the discovery of electricity?
examples.zh: 谁被认为发现了电？

examples.en: Leonardo made many scientific discoveries.
examples.zh: 列奥纳多有许多科学发现。

examples.en: They went on a voyage of discovery.
examples.zh: 他们进行了一次发现之旅。

examples.en: We don't know the exact number of people with the virus.
examples.zh: 我们不知道携带病毒的确切人数。

examples.en: Six months ago, her name was almost unknown here.
examples.zh: 六个月前，她的名字在这里几乎不为人知。

examples.en: Unknown to me, she planned a party for my birthday.
examples.zh: 我不知道，她为我的生日策划了一场聚会。

examples.en: She has travelled widely around the world.
examples.zh: 她曾广泛游历世界各地。

examples.en: His plays are still widely shown in the USA.
examples.zh: 他的戏剧仍在美国广泛演出。

examples.en: French was widely spoken in Cambodia before.
examples.zh: 法语以前在柬埔寨被广泛使用。

examples.en: The garden strawberry is a big-fruit hybrid.
examples.zh: 花园草莓是一种大果实的杂交品种。

examples.en: The animal looks like a hybrid of a zebra and a horse.
examples.zh: 这种动物看起来像斑马和马的杂交。

examples.en: His music is an interesting hybrid of pop and classical.
examples.zh: 他的音乐是流行和古典的有趣混合。

examples.en: The title of his first book was "Decline and Fall".
examples.zh: 他的第一本书的书名是《衰落与覆灭》。

examples.en: This song's title is the same as the album's name.
examples.zh: 这首歌的标题和专辑的名字一样。

examples.en: The bridge appears in the movie's opening titles.
examples.zh: 那座桥出现在电影的开场字幕中。

examples.en: Agriculture still uses old ways in some countries.
examples.zh: 在一些国家，农业仍使用传统方法。

examples.en: The area's income mostly comes from agriculture.
examples.zh: 这个地区的收入主要来自农业。

examples.en: 70% of the people here do farming for food.
examples.zh: 这里70%的人靠农业维持生计。

examples.en: The big meal was not enough to satisfy his hunger.
examples.zh: 这顿大餐还不足以满足他的饥饿。

examples.en: She felt faint from hunger at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 九点钟时她因饥饿感到头晕。

examples.en: I often get hunger pangs in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 我下午经常感到饥饿的阵阵刺痛。

examples.en: I happened to see my teacher at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我碰巧在超市看到了我的老师。

examples.en: She happened to find a lost dog on her way home.
examples.zh: 她碰巧在回家路上发现了一只走失的狗。

examples.en: We happened to sit next to each other in the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们碰巧在电影院里坐在彼此旁边。

examples.en: Booking tickets early has the advantage of better seats.
examples.zh: 提前订票的优势是能坐到更好的座位。

examples.en: She had the advantages of money and beauty, but was not happy.
examples.zh: 她有金钱和美貌的优势，但并不快乐。

examples.en: It is to your advantage to agree with him.
examples.zh: 同意他的要求对你有好处。

examples.en: At present, we are learning English online.
examples.zh: 目前，我们正在网上学习英语。

examples.en: She is busy with her homework at present.
examples.zh: 她现在正忙着做作业。

examples.en: At present, the weather is warm and sunny.
examples.zh: 目前，天气温暖晴朗。

examples.en: Your contribution, no matter how small, is welcome.
examples.zh: 你的贡献，无论多小，都是受欢迎的。

examples.en: All contributions for the school magazine must arrive by August 1st.
examples.zh: 所有给校刊的投稿必须在八月一日前送到。

examples.en: This invention made a big contribution to road safety.
examples.zh: 这项发明对道路安全做出了重大贡献。

examples.en: Armed robberies have increased in the last few years.
examples.zh: 过去几年持械抢劫增加了。

examples.en: The project cost has increased a lot since it began.
examples.zh: 项目开始以来，成本增加了很多。

examples.en: Tourism to Antarctica has increased a lot in ten years.
examples.zh: 十年来去南极的旅游业增加了很多。

examples.en: Coke is used to produce steel.
examples.zh: 焦炭被用来生产钢铁。

examples.en: We watched a video about glass production steps.
examples.zh: 我们看了一部关于玻璃生产步骤的视频。

examples.en: The company's new car will go into production next year.
examples.zh: 公司的新车明年将投入生产。

examples.en: Good food helps children's healthy growth and development.
examples.zh: 好的食物有助于孩子们的健康成长和发展。

examples.en: The film showed the development of pop music over time.
examples.zh: 这部电影展示了流行音乐随时间的发展。

examples.en: The area has too little development and few factories.
examples.zh: 这个地区发展太少，工厂也很少。

examples.en: Robots can do the surgery for doctors.
examples.zh: 机器人可以替医生做手术。

examples.en: A robot can be used to deal with bombs.
examples.zh: 机器人可以用来处理炸弹。

examples.en: He played music like a robot, with no feeling.
examples.zh: 他像机器人一样演奏音乐，毫无感情。

examples.en: I was away for days, so I had lots of post for me.
examples.zh: 我离开了好几天，所以有很多邮件等着我。

examples.en: My secretary usually opens my post, unless it says "private".
examples.zh: 我的秘书通常打开我的邮件，除非上面写着“私人”。

examples.en: Has the post come yet?
examples.zh: 邮件到了吗？

examples.en: Walking is the best way to explore the countryside.
examples.zh: 散步是探索乡村的最好方式。

examples.en: Robots explore space now, not astronauts.
examples.zh: 现在是机器人探索太空，而不是宇航员。

examples.en: The children went to explore the woods.
examples.zh: 孩子们去探索森林了。

examples.en: Will spaceships with miners go to outer space someday?
examples.zh: 载着矿工的飞船有一天会去太空吗？

examples.en: The movie was about aliens from outer space.
examples.zh: 这部电影是关于来自太空的外星人的。

examples.en: They meet killers, aliens from outer space, and bad people.
examples.zh: 他们遇到杀手、来自太空的外星人和坏人。

examples.en: Doctors tried hard to reduce the swelling in her brain.
examples.zh: 医生们尽力减轻她大脑的肿胀。

examples.en: The accident caused permanent damage to his brain.
examples.zh: 那次事故对他的大脑造成了永久性损伤。

examples.en: His wife died because of a brain tumour.
examples.zh: 他的妻子死于脑肿瘤。

examples.en: We'll go whatever the weather is.
examples.zh: 无论天气如何，我们都会去。

examples.en: Whatever happens, I'll stand by you.
examples.zh: 无论发生什么，我都会支持你。

examples.en: Whatever people say, Mr. Meese is not afraid of a fight.
examples.zh: 无论别人怎么说，米斯先生都不怕打架。

examples.en: He wore a three-piece suit to the important meeting.
examples.zh: 他穿了一套三件套西装去参加重要会议。

examples.en: My father bought a two-piece suit for the interview.
examples.zh: 我爸爸为面试买了一套两件套西装。

examples.en: He wore a dark blue dinner suit at the evening party.
examples.zh: 他在晚会上穿了一套深蓝色的晚礼服西装。

examples.en: After the accident, the road was closed for two hours. Now traffic moves smoothly again.
examples.zh: 事故后，道路关闭了两小时。现在交通又顺畅了。

examples.en: We add lead to fuel to help car engines run smoothly.
examples.zh: 我们在燃料中加铅，帮助汽车发动机平稳运转。

examples.en: The pregnancy has gone smoothly so far.
examples.zh: 到目前为止，怀孕过程一直很顺利。

examples.en: In general, students like playing sports after class.
examples.zh: 总的来说，学生们喜欢课后运动。

examples.en: In general, the weather here is warm and sunny.
examples.zh: 总的来说，这里的天气温暖晴朗。

examples.en: In general, reading English books helps us learn more words.
examples.zh: 总的来说，阅读英语书能帮助我们学更多单词。

examples.en: They have 31 ice cream flavors, enough to satisfy everyone.
examples.zh: 他们有31种冰淇淋口味，足以满足每个人。

examples.en: Come on, satisfy my curiosity—what happened last night?
examples.zh: 来吧，满足我的好奇心——昨晚发生了什么？

examples.en: She satisfies all the job requirements.
examples.zh: 她满足这份工作的所有要求。

examples.en: Babies need care all the time.
examples.zh: 婴儿需要一直得到照顾。

examples.en: The doctor said I needed surgery.
examples.zh: 医生说我需要做手术。

examples.en: I need to go to the toilet.
examples.zh: 我需要去上厕所。

examples.en: The chickenpox and flu viruses are common in winter.
examples.zh: 水痘和流感病毒在冬天很常见。

examples.en: The AIDS virus spread quickly among people.
examples.zh: 艾滋病病毒在人群中传播得很快。

examples.en: I don't know what's wrong with her; maybe she has a virus.
examples.zh: 我不知道她怎么了，也许她感染了病毒。

examples.en: She no longer lives in this city.
examples.zh: 她不再住在这个城市了。

examples.en: I can no longer wait for the bus.
examples.zh: 我不能再等公交车了。

examples.en: They are no longer friends after the fight.
examples.zh: 争吵之后他们不再是朋友了。

examples.en: It still doesn't work properly.
examples.zh: 它还是不能正常工作。

examples.en: I am not dressed properly for this weather.
examples.zh: 我穿的衣服不适合这种天气。

examples.en: You should take it to get it repaired properly.
examples.zh: 你应该把它拿去好好修一下。

examples.en: Please complete the sentence with these words.
examples.zh: 请用这些词完成句子。

examples.en: He needs two cards to complete the set.
examples.zh: 他需要两张卡片来凑齐这套。

examples.en: A baby would complete her happiness.
examples.zh: 一个宝宝会使她的幸福变得完整。

examples.en: He always makes a mess when he cooks.
examples.zh: 他做饭时总是弄得乱七八糟。

examples.en: Jem's room is always in a mess.
examples.zh: 杰姆的房间总是乱七八糟的。

examples.en: Please clean up the mess in the kitchen now.
examples.zh: 请现在把厨房里乱七八糟的东西清理干净。

examples.en: She laid the baby on the bed.
examples.zh: 她把婴儿放在了床上。

examples.en: He laid the tray on the table.
examples.zh: 他把托盘放在了桌子上。

examples.en: She laid her book aside to answer the phone.
examples.zh: 她把书放在一边去接电话了。

examples.en: If you don't like what you bought, take it back to our store for your money.
examples.zh: 如果你不喜欢买的东西，可以把它退回我们的商店拿回钱。

examples.en: His new clothes are shown in all the big stores in London.
examples.zh: 他的新衣服在伦敦所有大商店里展示。

examples.en: More competition may make the company close its stores this year.
examples.zh: 更多的竞争可能让公司今年关闭它的商店。

examples.en: There is a 10p coin in my pocket.
examples.zh: 我的口袋里有一枚10便士硬币。

examples.en: He gave me a pound coin for the bus.
examples.zh: 他给了我一枚一英镑硬币坐公交车。

examples.en: The old man collected many gold coins.
examples.zh: 那位老人收集了许多金币。

examples.en: Please pay the electricity bill this week.
examples.zh: 请这周付电费账单。

examples.en: They sent us a bill for their work.
examples.zh: 他们把工作的账单寄给了我们。

examples.en: She ran up a big phone bill.
examples.zh: 她积欠了一大笔电话费。

examples.en: She has a small office for private talks.
examples.zh: 她有一个小办公室，用来进行私人谈话。

examples.en: I saw him reading my private papers.
examples.zh: 我看见他在读我的私人文件。

examples.en: The gate said: Private property, no entry!
examples.zh: 大门上写着：私人财产，禁止进入！

examples.en: Emily took a piece of writing paper and began to write.
examples.zh: 艾米丽拿了一张书写纸，开始写字。

examples.en: Dictionaries were often printed on thin paper.
examples.zh: 字典通常印在薄纸上。

examples.en: She gave me a small brown paper bag.
examples.zh: 她给了我一个小棕纸袋。

examples.en: The fire spread fast because the wind was strong.
examples.zh: 火因为风大而蔓延得很快。

examples.en: The illness spread from the liver to other parts of the body.
examples.zh: 这种病从肝脏扩散到了身体的其他部位。

examples.en: Student art can't cover over 20% of a wall, or it may spread fire to the ceiling.
examples.zh: 学生的画不能覆盖墙的百分之二十以上，否则火可能会蔓延到天花板。

examples.en: My bag got stuck in the bike wheel.
examples.zh: 我的包卡在自行车轮子里了。

examples.en: A wheel hit a rock and he lost control of the car.
examples.zh: 一个轮子撞到石头，他失去了对汽车的控制。

examples.en: My suitcase has wheels, so it is easier to carry.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱有轮子，所以更容易携带。

examples.en: Take one sleeping pill before bed.
examples.zh: 睡觉前吃一片安眠药。

examples.en: I take a vitamin pill every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一片维生素片。

examples.en: My mother takes three pills a day.
examples.zh: 我妈妈每天吃三片药。

examples.en: I'm unsure about what to do next. Can you help me?
examples.zh: 我不确定下一步该做什么。你能帮我吗？

examples.en: As a new teacher, I was unsure of myself in front of the class.
examples.zh: 作为新老师，我在全班面前对自己没把握。

examples.en: Officials were unsure who controlled the city.
examples.zh: 官员们不确定谁控制着这座城市。

examples.en: She is old and very forgetful now.
examples.zh: 她现在老了，很健忘。

examples.en: She worries because her father is becoming forgetful.
examples.zh: 她担心，因为她爸爸变得健忘。

examples.en: My grandpa is forgetful and often loses his keys.
examples.zh: 我爷爷很健忘，经常丢钥匙。

examples.en: Go up the stairs and you will see her office on the right.
examples.zh: 走上楼梯，你会看到她的办公室在右边。

examples.en: The top stair made a sound and woke her mother.
examples.zh: 最上面那级楼梯发出声响，吵醒了她妈妈。

examples.en: He walked up the wooden stair and knocked at his grandpa's door.
examples.zh: 他走上木楼梯，敲了敲爷爷的门。

examples.en: This is a rechargeable battery.
examples.zh: 这是一块可充电电池。

examples.en: This alarm clock needs two medium batteries.
examples.zh: 这个闹钟需要两节中号电池。

examples.en: My phone's battery is going to run out.
examples.zh: 我手机的电量快用完了。

examples.en: Look, that satisfied customer is leaving now.
examples.zh: 看，那位满意的顾客现在要走了。

examples.en: Mrs Wilson is a regular customer of our shop.
examples.zh: 威尔逊太太是我们店的一位老顾客。

examples.en: Our shop has many loyal customers from nearby.
examples.zh: 我们店有很多附近的老顾客。

examples.en: Can you hold my bag for a minute?
examples.zh: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？

examples.en: He held a gun in his hand.
examples.zh: 他手里握着一把枪。

examples.en: The little girl held her mom's hand.
examples.zh: 小女孩握着妈妈的手。

examples.en: They walked through the woods slowly.
examples.zh: 他们慢慢地穿过树林。

examples.en: The boy walked through the water to his boat.
examples.zh: 那个男孩蹚过水到达他的船。

examples.en: He pushed through the crowd to the front.
examples.zh: 他挤过人群到了前面。

examples.en: Can you put me through to Mr. Li, please?
examples.zh: 请帮我接通李先生的电话，好吗？

examples.en: The operator put the call through to the manager.
examples.zh: 接线员把电话接通到了经理那里。

examples.en: Please put me through to the hospital right now.
examples.zh: 请立刻帮我接通医院的电话。

examples.en: Some people are never satisfied with anything.
examples.zh: 有些人从不对任何事情感到满意。

examples.en: She gave me a satisfied smile.
examples.zh: 她给了我一个满意的微笑。

examples.en: Are you satisfied with the new plan?
examples.zh: 你对新计划满意吗？

examples.en: She is satisfied with her exam results.
examples.zh: 她对她的考试结果感到满意。

examples.en: We were satisfied with the service in the restaurant.
examples.zh: 我们对餐厅的服务感到满意。

examples.en: He will be satisfied with your hard work.
examples.zh: 他会对你的努力感到满意。

examples.en: First of all, let me introduce myself to you.
examples.zh: 首先，让我向你介绍一下我自己。

examples.en: First of all, we need to finish our homework.
examples.zh: 首先，我们需要完成作业。

examples.en: First of all, turn off the lights before you leave.
examples.zh: 首先，离开前请关灯。

examples.en: The shop sells goods of top quality.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售质量上乘的商品。

examples.en: The food was poor in quality.
examples.zh: 这食物质量很差。

examples.en: The cuts may lower the quality of service.
examples.zh: 削减可能会降低服务质量。

examples.en: His homework is not up to standard, so he must do it again.
examples.zh: 他的作业没有达到标准，所以他必须重做。

examples.en: The food in this restaurant is always up to standard.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅的食物总是能达到标准。

examples.en: You need to make your work up to standard before Friday.
examples.zh: 你需要在周五前让你的工作达到标准。

examples.en: I completely agree with you.
examples.zh: 我完全同意你。

examples.en: She is completely crazy.
examples.zh: 她完全疯了。

examples.en: He completely changed, so I didn't know him.
examples.zh: 他完全变了，所以我认不出他了。

examples.en: I left school at 16, but I have no regrets about my life.
examples.zh: 我16岁离开学校，但对我的生活不后悔。

examples.en: The manager felt great regret about the job cuts.
examples.zh: 经理对裁员感到非常遗憾。

examples.en: To our regret, we can't visit you next year.
examples.zh: 遗憾的是，我们明年不能去看你了。

examples.en: They make many skin-care products.
examples.zh: 他们生产许多护肤品。

examples.en: This product is so good that it sells itself.
examples.zh: 这个产品好到不用推销。

examples.en: I want to eat fewer dairy products.
examples.zh: 我想少吃奶制品。

examples.en: Mars is called the Red Planet because of its color.
examples.zh: 火星因为它的颜色被称为红色星球。

examples.en: Is there life on Mars? We don't know.
examples.zh: 火星上有生命吗？我们不知道。

examples.en: We found Mars on the space map.
examples.zh: 我们在太空地图上找到了火星。

examples.en: He wore a crash helmet on his head.
examples.zh: 他头上戴了一个防撞头盔。

examples.en: She bought a new bicycle helmet yesterday.
examples.zh: 她昨天买了一个新的自行车头盔。

examples.en: Riding a bike without a helmet is dangerous.
examples.zh: 骑自行车不戴头盔很危险。

examples.en: The diver carried an air tank on his back.
examples.zh: 潜水员背上背着一个氧气罐。

examples.en: She checked the air tank before going underwater.
examples.zh: 她在下水前检查了氧气罐。

examples.en: We need a new air tank for the swimming class.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个新的氧气罐来上游泳课。

examples.en: We took some dried food on our trip.
examples.zh: 我们旅行时带了一些干粮。

examples.en: The soldiers ate dried food in the mountains.
examples.zh: 士兵们在山里吃干粮。

examples.en: My mom keeps dried food for the winter.
examples.zh: 我妈妈为冬天储存干粮。

examples.en: His laptop was off, and the power pack and phone cord were on top of it.
examples.zh: 他的笔记本电脑关着，电源包和手机线放在上面。

examples.en: I will buy a power pack for my phone before the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期前我会给我的手机买一个电源包。

examples.en: The power pack can fit on most wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 这个电源包能装在大多数轮椅上。

examples.en: Buy a sleeping bag that is warm and light.
examples.zh: 买一个又暖和又轻的睡袋。

examples.en: One night, he wakes up in his sleeping bag.
examples.zh: 一天晚上，他在睡袋里醒来。

examples.en: You also need a sleeping bag for the trip.
examples.zh: 你也需要一个睡袋去旅行。

examples.en: We learned about the laws of gravity in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上学习了重力定律。

examples.en: You don't understand the gravity of this problem.
examples.zh: 你不明白这个问题的严重性。

examples.en: The gravity of the earth pulls things down.
examples.zh: 地球的重力把东西往下拉。

examples.en: We live on the planet Earth.
examples.zh: 我们生活在地球这颗行星上。

examples.en: Venus is a very hot planet.
examples.zh: 金星是一颗非常热的行星。

examples.en: Is there smart life on other planets?
examples.zh: 其他行星上有智慧生命吗？

examples.en: The bar was crowded by ten o'clock.
examples.zh: 到十点钟时，酒吧里很拥挤。

examples.en: The shops get more crowded as Christmas comes.
examples.zh: 随着圣诞节来临，商店变得越来越拥挤。

examples.en: Chen nodded to her in the crowded room.
examples.zh: 陈在拥挤的房间里向她点头示意。

examples.en: The river in Caracas is heavily polluted.
examples.zh: 加拉加斯的河流被严重污染了。

examples.en: New particles form in the polluted air of big cities.
examples.zh: 大城市被污染的空气中会形成新的颗粒物。

examples.en: Poor people drank the polluted water and were hurt most.
examples.zh: 穷人喝了被污染的水，受到的影响最大。

examples.en: The 1990s saw rapid growth in technology.
examples.zh: 20世纪90年代科技发展迅速。

examples.en: A rapid move on my left surprised me.
examples.zh: 我左边一个快速的动作吓了我一跳。

examples.en: He gave a rapid answer to the blame.
examples.zh: 他对指责做出了快速的回应。

examples.en: Please read the text all over again.
examples.zh: 请把课文再读一遍。

examples.en: He did the homework all over again.
examples.zh: 他把作业重新做了一遍。

examples.en: We can start the game all over again.
examples.zh: 我们可以重新开始这场比赛。

examples.en: Car passengers must wear seat belts.
examples.zh: 汽车乘客必须系安全带。

examples.en: Two passenger trains crashed in the accident.
examples.zh: 两辆客运列车在事故中相撞了。

examples.en: The strike stopped some ferries, so many passengers waited at the docks.
examples.zh: 罢工使一些渡轮停运，许多乘客在码头等待。

examples.en: The car is running at the speed of 80 kilometers an hour.
examples.zh: 那辆汽车正以每小时80公里的速度行驶。

examples.en: Light travels at the speed of about 300,000 kilometers per second.
examples.zh: 光以每秒大约30万公里的速度传播。

examples.en: He walked at a speed of 5 kilometers per hour to the school.
examples.zh: 他以每小时5公里的速度走到学校。

examples.en: I ate so much that I feel uncomfortable now.
examples.zh: 我吃得太多了，现在感觉不舒服。

examples.en: These shoes make my feet uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 这双鞋让我的脚不舒服。

examples.en: We waited in an uncomfortable silence.
examples.zh: 我们在令人不安的沉默中等待。

examples.en: Oxygen has atomic number 8, meaning 8 protons in its nucleus.
examples.zh: 氧的原子序数是8，意味着它的原子核中有8个质子。

examples.en: Plants give us most of the oxygen in the air.
examples.zh: 植物为我们提供了空气中大部分的氧气。

examples.en: Air is mostly made of nitrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 空气主要由氮气和氧气组成。

examples.en: We can get energy in the form of food.
examples.zh: 我们可以通过食物的形式获取能量。

examples.en: The teacher gave us advice in the form of a story.
examples.zh: 老师以讲故事的形式给我们提建议。

examples.en: She showed her love in the form of a gift.
examples.zh: 她用礼物的形式表达了她的爱。

examples.en: This soup is really tasty.
examples.zh: 这汤真美味。

examples.en: We had a tasty meal yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天吃了一顿美味的饭。

examples.en: She made a tasty dessert for us.
examples.zh: 她为我们做了美味的甜点。

examples.en: This wine is specially good.
examples.zh: 这酒特别好。

examples.en: Do you want to go out? Not specially.
examples.zh: 你想出去吗？不太想。

examples.en: The kids liked the museum, specially the dinosaurs.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢博物馆，特别是恐龙。

examples.en: Compare the two houses, and you will see the price difference.
examples.zh: 比较这两栋房子，你就会看到价格差异。

examples.en: Have you compared prices in other shops? That seems too expensive.
examples.zh: 你比较过其他商店的价格吗？那似乎太贵了。

examples.en: Compare your new work with your old work, and you will see your progress.
examples.zh: 把你的新作品和旧作品比较一下，你就会看到你的进步。

examples.en: Compare your answers with mine to find mistakes.
examples.zh: 把你的答案和我的相比，找出错误。

examples.en: People often compare the city to a big garden.
examples.zh: 人们常把这座城市比作一个大花园。

examples.en: Compared with last year, we did much better.
examples.zh: 与去年相比，我们做得好多了。

examples.en: The spaceship moved through interplanetary space.
examples.zh: 飞船穿过行星间的空间。

examples.en: Interplanetary travel is very exciting but hard.
examples.zh: 行星间的旅行很刺激但很难。

examples.en: The probe sent photos from interplanetary space.
examples.zh: 探测器从行星间发回了照片。

examples.en: There is a network of tunnels under the city.
examples.zh: 城市地下有一个隧道网络。

examples.en: She works for a television network.
examples.zh: 她在一家电视网络公司工作。

examples.en: The country has a large road network.
examples.zh: 这个国家有庞大的公路网络。

examples.en: This is a challenging time for all of us.
examples.zh: 这对我们所有人来说都是一段具有挑战性的时期。

examples.en: Finding a job in this city is quite challenging.
examples.zh: 在这个城市找工作相当有挑战性。

examples.en: The exam was really challenging for us.
examples.zh: 这场考试对我们来说真的很有挑战性。

examples.en: Things are changing rapidly now.
examples.zh: 现在事情变化得很快。

examples.en: The country's oil is running out rapidly.
examples.zh: 这个国家的石油正在迅速耗尽。

examples.en: It is a city growing rapidly in industry.
examples.zh: 这是一个工业快速发展的城市。

examples.en: I wasn't even aware that he was ill.
examples.zh: 我甚至没意识到他生病了。

examples.en: Were you aware of the risks then?
examples.zh: 你当时知道这些风险吗？

examples.en: She was very aware that he was married.
examples.zh: 她很清楚他已经结婚了。

examples.en: We cut colored paper into circles.
examples.zh: 我们把彩纸剪成了圆形。

examples.en: We sat in a circle on the floor.
examples.zh: 我们坐在地板上围成一圈。

examples.en: The teacher told us to make a circle and hold hands.
examples.zh: 老师让我们围成圈并手拉手。

examples.en: What's the distance between your home and school?
examples.zh: 你家和学校之间的距离是多少？

examples.en: The distance from here to the station is 5 km.
examples.zh: 从这里到车站的距离是5公里。

examples.en: He walks a long distance to work every day.
examples.zh: 他每天走很远的距离去上班。

examples.en: It may not happen, but I won't rule out the possibility.
examples.zh: 这事可能不会发生，但我不会排除这种可能性。

examples.en: The weather report says there is a possibility of snow tonight.
examples.zh: 天气预报说今晚有可能下雪。

examples.en: There is a clear possibility that I will give a speech.
examples.zh: 我很可能要发表演讲，这有明显的可能性。

examples.en: People saw an alien spacecraft in the sky last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚人们在空中看到了一个外星飞船。

examples.en: When I first came to this city, everything felt alien to me.
examples.zh: 当我第一次来到这座城市时，一切都让我觉得陌生。

examples.en: The story is about a boy who meets an alien culture.
examples.zh: 这个故事是关于一个男孩遇到了外星文化。

examples.en: I have doubts about his ability to do the job.
examples.zh: 我对他做这份工作的能力有疑问。

examples.en: If there is any doubt about the rocket's engines, we should cancel the launch.
examples.zh: 如果对火箭发动机有任何疑问，我们应该取消发射。

examples.en: The company's actions made us doubt if it can save its losing business.
examples.zh: 公司的行为让我们怀疑它能否挽救亏损的业务。

examples.en: My mother told me not to talk to strangers.
examples.zh: 我妈妈告诉我不要和陌生人说话。

examples.en: At the party, everyone there was a stranger to me.
examples.zh: 聚会上，那里的每个人对我来说都是陌生人。

examples.en: Are you a stranger here, or do you know the way?
examples.zh: 你是这里的外地人，还是你知道路？

examples.en: We will carry out the plan next week.
examples.zh: 我们将于下周执行这个计划。

examples.en: The students carried out a survey about hobbies.
examples.zh: 学生们开展了一项关于爱好的调查。

examples.en: Please carry out the teacher's instructions carefully.
examples.zh: 请仔细执行老师的指示。

examples.en: What percentage of mothers go back to work?
examples.zh: 有多少百分比的母亲会回去工作？

examples.en: The interest rate went up by two percentage points.
examples.zh: 利率上升了两个百分点。

examples.en: The percentage of live births keeps growing.
examples.zh: 活产婴儿的百分率持续增长。

examples.en: One disadvantage of living in a town is few safe places for kids to play.
examples.zh: 住在城镇的一个不利之处是孩子们安全玩耍的地方很少。

examples.en: We must think about whether the plan's disadvantages are bigger than its advantages.
examples.zh: 我们必须思考这个计划的不利之处是否大于它的好处。

examples.en: Being very shy puts him at a disadvantage.
examples.zh: 非常害羞使他处于不利地位。

examples.en: This business has high risks, but also high rewards.
examples.zh: 这一行风险高，回报也高。

examples.en: There is a high risk of another accident in this fog.
examples.zh: 这场雾里再出事故的风险很高。

examples.en: The risk of failing made us work twice as hard.
examples.zh: 失败的风险让我们加倍努力。

examples.en: Don't worry about the exam, after all, you studied hard.
examples.zh: 别担心考试，毕竟你努力学习过。

examples.en: It's late, after all, we should go home now.
examples.zh: 天晚了，毕竟我们现在该回家了。

examples.en: She is a beginner, after all, so be patient with her.
examples.zh: 她毕竟是初学者，所以对她要有耐心。

examples.en: All electrical goods are 25% off this week.
examples.zh: 所有电器商品这周打七五折。

examples.en: House insurance won't cover your personal goods.
examples.zh: 房屋保险不保你的个人物品。

examples.en: They sell food and household goods.
examples.zh: 他们卖食物和家居用品。

examples.en: I want to buy an electronic keyboard.
examples.zh: 我想买一个电子琴。

examples.en: We need electronic devices for school.
examples.zh: 我们需要电子设备来上学。

examples.en: The singer used electronic sound to amplify his voice.
examples.zh: 这位歌手用电子声音来放大他的嗓音。

examples.en: This town has little entertainment, only a cinema and two pubs.
examples.zh: 这个镇上娱乐活动很少，只有一家电影院和两家酒吧。

examples.en: This season's entertainment includes five new plays and some music concerts.
examples.zh: 这个季度的娱乐活动包括五部新剧和一些音乐会。

examples.en: This film is good entertainment for the whole family.
examples.zh: 这部电影是适合全家观看的好娱乐。
